## K-04  Flags, not hindsight

Every 6 hours it takes five readings straight from the portal's own tables:

- failed sign-ins in the last hour, and across how many accounts (a run against several accounts is password guessing)
- delete actions in the audit trail in 24 hours
- compliance items that went overdue this week - a growing backlog, not a static one
- lead volume halving against the previous day, which usually means a portal feed or an ad account has broken quietly
- leads sitting unassigned

**It sends nothing when nothing is wrong** - so an email from it always means something. Every threshold is in the Config node.

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_attempts
     WHERE at > to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '1 hour',
                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))                AS failed_logins_1h,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT identifier) FROM login_attempts
     WHERE at > to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '1 hour',
                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))                AS failed_login_accounts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log
     WHERE action ILIKE '%delete%'
       AND at > to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '24 hours',
                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))                AS deletions_24h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log
     WHERE at > to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '24 hours',
                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))                AS audit_events_24h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracked WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE)      AS overdue_now,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracked
     WHERE due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 AND CURRENT_DATE - 1)  AS newly_overdue_7d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001
     WHERE created_at >= to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '24 hours',
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))       AS leads_24h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001
     WHERE created_at >= to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '48 hours',
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
       AND created_at <  to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '24 hours',
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))       AS leads_prev_24h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001
     WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('New','Contacted')
       AND COALESCE(NULLIF(agent_assigned,''), '') = '')            AS leads_unassigned;
